mapper.sql: b.id, b.department_id, b.fiscal_year, b.quarter, b.gl_account_code, b.allocated_amount, b.currency, b.status, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type IN ('COMMIT_TENTATIVE', 'COMMIT_FIRM') THEN t.amount WHEN t.transaction_type = 'RELEASE' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS committed_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'SPEND' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spent_amount, b.allocated_amount - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type IN ('COMMIT_TENTATIVE', 'COMMIT_FIRM') THEN t.amount WHEN t.transaction_type = 'RELEASE' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'SPEND' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_amount
GROUP BY b.id, b.department_id, b.fiscal_year, b.quarter, b.gl_account_code, b.allocated_amount, b.currency, b.status
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM finance.budgets b LEFT JOIN finance.budget_transactions t ON t.budget_id = b.id
ORDER BY
b.department_id b.quarter b.gl_account_code b.status b.allocated_amount committed_amount spent_amount available_amount b.fiscal_year
ASC DESC , b.gl_account_code ASC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{filter.offset}

SELECT
FROM finance.budgets b LEFT JOIN finance.budget_transactions t ON t.budget_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{budgetId} AND b.is_deleted = FALSE
